jobs.title: Security Researcher
jobs.description: Security Researcher - Planet Nine About Solutions Products & Services Newsroom Career Contact Contact Us Contact Us Security Researcher We are looking for a skilled Defensive Vulnerability Researcher to join our top-tier security team. You’ll identify and analyze vulnerabilities across software, firmware, and embedded systems using advanced reverse engineering. The role includes developing tools and automation to support vulnerability research, static and dynamic analysis, and custom testing techniques. You’ll collaborate closely with the team, contribute to innovative research, and drive real-world impact in critical infrastructure security. Role & Responsibilities Defensive Vulnerability Research – Identify and analyze software and hardware flaws through reverse engineering of binaries, firmware, and applications (Windows, Linux, Embedded). Root-Cause & Mitigation: Conduct vulnerability discovery, triage, and exploit analysis; propose mitigations and secure design improvements. Tooling & Automation: Build tools and scripts to streamline vulnerability research, static/dynamic analysis, and fuzzing workflows. Secure Design Review: Evaluate codebases and architectures for security weaknesses; collaborate with engineering teams to harden systems. Disclosure & Collaboration: Support coordinated disclosure processes with vendors and document findings in detailed technical reports. Research & Innovation: Explore new techniques in reverse engineering, vulnerability discovery, and exploit mitigation. Team & Impact: Work alongside a world-class research team on advanced and impactful defensive security projects. Independence & Creativity: Pursue independent vulnerability research and disclosure initiatives that contribute to global security resilience. Requirements 5+ years experience in vulnerability research and exploitation (Hands-On). 5+ years experience in reverse engineering using tools such as IDA Pro, Ghidra, or Binary Ninja (Hands-On). Strong programming and scripting experience (C/C++, Python, or equivalent). Familiarity with modern OS internals (Windows and/or Linux). Ability to work within a team while leading complex research missions. Nice to Have Prior contributions to security research publications or CVEs. Experience with fuzzing frameworks (AFL, libFuzzer, Honggfuzz). Familiarity with secure software development practices and code auditing. Knowledge of embedded systems or mobile platform security. Apply for this Position Submit your resume using the form below, or send it to CV@Planet-Nine.io along with the position name About Solutions Products & Services Newsroom Career Contact Privacy Policy Terms All rights reserved Planet Nine 2026 ©

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: AI/ML Engineer - Planet Nine About Solutions Products & Services Newsroom Career Contact Contact Us Contact Us AI/ML Engineer We are looking for a technical AI/ML Engineer to own the AI strategy and execution at Planet Nine. In this role, you will split your time between managing a small team of two AI researchers and remaining highly hands-on-actively architecting, training, and deploying models. You will serve as the primary AI authority within the company, responsible for inventing efficient solutions to novel problems. We need a pragmatic decision-maker who knows how to evaluate when to build models from scratch, when to fine-tune, and when to leverage existing technology to maximize impact. Since our projects focus on challenges without established blueprints, you will keep pace with recent AI developments and know how to integrate them effectively into our products. Responsibilities AI Ownership & Strategy: Act as the primary owner for AI/ML initiatives across Planet Nine, aligning technical capabilities with our cybersecurity goals. Hands-on Execution (60%+): Take direct responsibility for the complete ML lifecycle—from data preparation and custom model training to evaluation, deployment, and production maintenance. Problem Solving & Invention: Invent and design machine learning solutions for complex, novel problems in threat intelligence and cybersecurity that lack established blueprints. Pragmatic Architecture: Evaluate and make calculated decisions on when to build proprietary models from scratch, fine-tune existing models, or leverage off-the-shelf APIs. Team Management: Manage, guide, and mentor a high-caliber team of two AI researchers, fostering a collaborative and efficient development culture. Must Have 4+ years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning (ML), Deep Learning (DL), and Large Language Models (LLMs). Proven track record of both training custom models and effectively integrating or utilizing existing open-source and commercial models. Practical experience building and deploying applications using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and MCP (Model Context Protocol). Nice to Have Cybersecurity Background: Experience in cybersecurity or security research is a huge advantage Solid understanding of the complete ML lifecycle, including MLOps, model monitoring, and production maintenance. Prior experience in a leadership or management role, with the ability to guide and mentor researchers.
